Package management.service

Class ModifyService

  • java.lang.Object
    • management.service.ModifyService
  • public class ModifyService
extends java.lang.Object
    This is a control class for modify account.

    This class provides service related to modification, like changing prices, stocks, poster and recommended add-on and other operations .

    Author:
    Xiaotian Wang
